findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed member of staff to not use barrier when turning off handwashing faucet. Discussed with PIC, education on proper handwashing was provided and employee rewashed hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed container of cut potatoes to be resting on floor. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and potatoes were moved to table. Ensure all food items are kept at least 6 inches off of ground to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed multiple sets of plates to not be inverted or stored under shelf. Discussed with PIC, plates were moved to under shelf unit. Ensure clean plates are stored in way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(B) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (B) Clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be stored: (1) In a self-draining position that allows air drying; and (2) Covered or inverted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to the left of dish machine to be in a a state of disrepair. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Observed mold accumulation in the following areas: 
(Repeat) 1) The bar soda gun. 

Discussed with PIC, soda gun was cleaned with a sanitizing solution. Ensure soda guns are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed dish machine to be testing at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer line was adjusted and dish machine tested at 100ppm CL. Ensure facility is monitoring dish machine to ensure sanitizer levels are at the proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Observed mold accumulation in the following areas:
1) The ice machine in the basement. 
2) The bar soda gun. 

Discussed with PIC, both locations will be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure staff is cleaning as needed to prevent any mold accumulation. Inspector will follow up on 10/24/25.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed the triple sink to the right of dish machine to be leaking at the faucet. Discussed with PIC, leak will be serviced by a licensed plumber. Ensure no leaks are present within facility.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.11(A) Approved System and Cleanable Fixtures. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed a container of sauce to be hot holding at 120F. Discussed with PIC, the hot holding unit was not plugged in. The sauce was moved to the stove and reheated to 165F. Ensure any TCS food being hot held is kept at or above 135F. 

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be missing/damaged in the following areas:
1) To the left of the kitchen dish machine.
2) The triple sink to the right of the dish machine.

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being checked regularly. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
In-house made cocktail sauce was observed to be held past the 7 day maximum.  Discussed with PIC, who discarded items.  Ensure foods are discarded after 7 days.

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following physical facility areas in need of repairs:
1. Majority of the equipment in the kitchen needs re-caulked to the wall. The kitchen was recently re-painted and the equipment was not re-caulked at this time (was expected to be).
2. The facility had a fire recently. The wall with the AC unit (to the right of the cook line) was replaced with new stainless steel and Nudo board. The wood that is covering the window (where AC unit is) needs to be painted and the framing should be caulked.
3. The wall above the hot holding steam table (to the left of the cook line) needs re-dry walled and painted.
4. Coving is needed near the mop area and by the salad prep cooler.
5. Bar hand sink is missing caulk to the wall - caulk the hand sink.

Discussed the above areas with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.
